result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: a broken/missing restaurant cover image in the 'Popular right now' section. Other partially visible items are intentional horizontal scrolling and bottom-of-viewport cutoff.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card's cover image has failed to load, showing a plain light-grey placeholder with a broken-image icon in the center instead of a restaurant/food photo, unlike the other restaurant cards which display images.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source/URL for Tokumaru Ramen Bar, verify the asset exists on the CDN, and add a proper loading fallback/retry so a broken-image placeholder is not shown to users.
